description: Korean industrial accident reporting: the accident investigation report (산업재해조사표) is due within 1 month of an accident causing death or 3+ days off work (산업안전보건법 제57조③, 시행규칙 제73조; next business day if the last day is a holiday); serious accidents must be reported immediately by phone/fax (제54조②). Fines (시행령 별표 35, amended 2026-07-28): not reporting 7M/10M/15M KRW by offence count, false report 15M, serious accident not reported 30M. Concealment is a crime (1 year prison or 10M fine, 제170조), not a fine. Information only; no filing.

nth.description: Offence count in the last 5 years incl. this one (1-3)

reported.description: Date the report was filed (omit if not yet)

serious.description: Serious accident under the OSH Act

today.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD for days left (default: today)
